components.css: .ds-link{font-family:var(--sans, "DM Sans", Arial, sans-serif);display:inline-flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;gap:28px;color:var(--ink,#263d32);font-size:13px;line-height:1.5;padding:13px 0;border-bottom:1px solid currentColor;text-decoration:none}.ds-link svg{transition:transform .3s var(--ease,cubic-bezier(.22,1,.36,1))}.ds-link:hover svg{transform:translateX(4px)}.ds-link:focus-visible{outline:2px solid #768d55;outline-offset:6px}@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.ds-link svg{transition:none}}

components.name: Inquiry field
components.description: Visible label with a transparent, underlined text field.
components.css: .ds-field{font-family:var(--sans, "DM Sans", Arial, sans-serif);display:block;color:var(--ink,#263d32);font-size:12px}.ds-field input{font:inherit;color:inherit;display:block;width:100%;background:transparent;border:0;border-bottom:1px solid #a8b3a1;border-radius:0;padding:15px 0 13px;margin-top:6px;font-size:14px;line-height:1.6;min-height:48px;caret-color:var(--forest,#243c30)}.ds-field input::placeholder{color:#677162;opacity:1}.ds-field input:focus{border-bottom-color:var(--forest,#243c30)}.ds-field input:focus-visible{outline:2px solid #768d55;outline-offset:6px}@media(max-width:700px){.ds-field input{font-size:16px}}

components.css: .ds-nav{display:flex;gap:38px;font-family:var(--sans, "DM Sans", Arial, sans-serif);color:var(--ink,#263d32)}.ds-nav a{position:relative;padding:14px 0;font-size:13px;color:inherit;text-decoration:none}.ds-nav a:after{position:absolute;content:"";height:1px;left:0;bottom:8px;width:100%;background:currentColor;transform:scaleX(0);transform-origin:left;transition:transform .2s}.ds-nav a:hover:after,.ds-nav a[aria-current]:after{transform:scaleX(1)}.ds-nav a:focus-visible{outline:2px solid #768d55;outline-offset:6px}@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.ds-nav a:after{transition:none}}

components.css: .ds-collection{display:block;max-width:380px;color:var(--ink,#263d32);text-decoration:none}.ds-cover{position:relative;overflow:hidden;aspect-ratio:4/5;background:var(--pale,#e9eadf)}.ds-cover img{display:block;width:100%;height:100%;object-fit:cover;transition:transform .7s var(--ease,cubic-bezier(.22,1,.36,1))}.ds-collection:hover img{transform:scale(1.025)}.ds-open{font-family:var(--sans, "DM Sans", Arial, sans-serif);position:absolute;inset:auto 20px 20px;display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center;padding:14px 18px;background:var(--paper,#f5f3ec);font-size:12px;transform:translateY(80px);transition:transform .4s var(--ease,cubic-bezier(.22,1,.36,1))}.ds-collection:hover .ds-open,.ds-collection:focus-visible .ds-open{transform:translateY(0)}.ds-collection h3{font-family:var(--serif,"Cormorant Garamond",Georgia,serif);font-size:clamp(30px,3vw,42px);font-weight:400;line-height:1.02;letter-spacing:-.015em;margin:23px 0 0}.ds-collection p{font-family:var(--sans, "DM Sans", Arial, sans-serif);font-size:11px;color:var(--muted,#60695f);margin:8px 0 0;line-height:1.75}.ds-collection:focus-visible{outline:2px solid #768d55;outline-offset:6px}@media(max-width:700px){.ds-open{display:none}}@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.ds-cover img,.ds-open{transition:none}}

narrative.overview:
Original photographs set the pace. Warm paper, forest ink, restrained captions, and large serif headings make room for locations and people to carry the identity. Staggered spreads alternate with quieter introductions and print presentations.

The system is built for a web experience: visitors browse photographs, open collections, and reach a direct inquiry. This document describes the implemented system in `src/app/globals.css` and the React components; the homepage strategy lives separately in `.impeccable/surfaces/`.
keyCharacteristics: Literary headings with small, clear sans-serif navigation and captions.
Square image edges, fine rules, and pale regional backgrounds.
Native scrolling with restrained image and link motion.
dos: Do use Nicholas's original photographs and grounded collection names.
Do preserve the hierarchy of image, title, and restrained caption.
Do use the final square portrait sizing instead of enlarging the 300px source.
Do retain manual controls, visible focus, and reduced-motion behavior.
donts: Don't invent testimonials, clients, print prices, or availability claims.
Don't replace original photography with generated or stock imagery presented as Nicholas's.
Don't add generic rounded card containers to collection spreads.
